dataset_name: Chetna M1 Day 1 Hotspots and Backtest Development Dataset

metadata.description: Standardized M1 Day 1 training and validation foundation connecting chronic waterlogging locations to historical backtest rainfall series.
hotspot_sources: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) Chronic Waterlogging Hotspots Registry
Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority (TNSDMA)
rainfall_sources: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis)

hotspots.name: Velachery Vijayanagar Junction
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Low-lying basin surrounded by urban development; runoff bottleneck into Pallikaranai marshland with flat discharge gradient.
hotspots.source_reference: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) Chronic Waterlogging Hotspots Registry / TNSDMA

hotspots.name: Madipakkam (Ram Nagar / Kuberan Nagar)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Reclaimed agricultural/lake bed adjacent to Pallikaranai wetland; lacks natural gravitational storm runoff outfall.
hotspots.source_reference: GCC Flood Mitigation Master Plan / CMWSSB Basin Studies

hotspots.name: Mudichur (Varadharajapuram / Mudichur Road)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Direct floodplain of Adyar river tributary and surplus overflow channels from Chembarambakkam catchment basin.
hotspots.source_reference: State Disaster Management Authority (TNSDMA) & CWC Adyar Basin Reports

hotspots.name: T. Nagar (Usman Road / Bazullah Road / GN Chetty)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Extremely high surface imperviousness (near 90%); micro-drain overflow into silted Mambalam Canal causing reverse urban backflow.
hotspots.source_reference: Chennai Smart City Mission / GCC Stormwater Audit

hotspots.name: Pulianthope (Dr. Ambedkar College Road / Demellows Road)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: North Chennai low-elevation bowl adjacent to Buckingham Canal; historical stagnation zone affected by high tide backflow.
hotspots.source_reference: GCC North Chennai Flood Audits & Health Dept Vector Control Records

hotspots.name: Vyasarpadi (Ganesapuram Subway / Jeeva Railway Station)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Sub-grade depression subway receiving stormwater from surrounding road networks; pump failure rapidly submerges subway.
hotspots.source_reference: Greater Chennai Traffic Police Advisory Records & GCC Subway Pump Station Logs

hotspots.name: Perambur (Stephenson Road Subway / Otteri Nullah)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Otteri Nullah canal banks overflow into adjacent low-lying roads and railway underpasses.
hotspots.source_reference: GCC Monsoon Action Plan / PWD Water Resources Department Records

hotspots.name: Koyambedu (SAF Games Village / Wholesale Market / PH Road)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Cooum River high water levels prevent storm drain discharge; massive surface runoff from market and bus terminal pavement.
hotspots.source_reference: Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority (CMDA) / GCC Zone 8 Logs

hotspots.name: Manapakkam (MIOT Hospital / Mount-Poonamallee Road)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Major sharp bend and narrowing in the Adyar River corridor; river water breaches embankments into hospitals and arterial roads.
hotspots.source_reference: TNSDMA Disaster Review 2015 & 2023 / CWC Flood Gauging Station Manapakkam

hotspots.name: Pallikaranai (Kamakshi Hospital / Velachery-Tambaram Road)
hotspots.primary_vulnerability_cause: Central drainage sink for South Chennai; culvert capacity along 200 Feet Radial Road is insufficient during extreme monsoon discharge.
hotspots.source_reference: Dept of Environment, Climate Change & Forests (TN) / Pallikaranai Conservation Authority
critical_infrastructure_nearby: IT Corridor 200 Feet Radial Link Road

events.name: Cyclone Michaung Heavy Inundation
events.impact_summary: Extensive neighborhood inundation across South and Central Chennai; water depths between 1.5m to 2.5m in Velachery, Madipakkam, and Tambaram; city paralyzed for over 72 hours.
events.source_reference: Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 / Copernicus) & India Meteorological Department (IMD) Special Monsoon Bulletin

events.name: November 2021 Deep Depression Inundation
events.classification: Moderate to High Flash Inundation Event
events.impact_summary: Sudden intense overnight rainfall caused severe flash waterlogging; all railway underpasses in North Chennai closed; over 500 arterial roads inundated.
events.source_reference: Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 / Copernicus) & GCC Monsoon Control Room Daily Situation Reports
